newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on firmer yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on firmer yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Monday in lacklustre trade, weighed down by the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 yen to 1.8 yen per kg lower. Benchmark October was off 1.7 yen at 142.2 yen.
The market was pressured by sporadic profit-taking, but the participation of market players were limited, as they were watching to see the currency market, the traders said.
They added the fact that trade was shifting its attention to relatively cheap Malaysian rubber from Thai rubber in producing countries, had little impact on Tokyo rubber futures.
